You have a cotton ball and medical tape, but we're using Band-Aids.
sentences.zh: 你用的是棉球和医用胶带，但我们这里用的都是创可贴。

sentences.en: And behind him, Phyllis walks up.
sentences.zh: 紧接着菲莉丝走了过来。

sentences.en: He's making a quick exit, and he just goes, Band-Aid.
sentences.zh: 他正打算迅速溜走，丢下一句：创可贴。

sentences.en: And then Creed leaves the truck with his blood in a bag, or someone else's.
sentences.zh: 然后柯里德手里提着一袋自己的血，或者别人的血，离开了献血车。

sentences.en: I don't know, but this is what Dwight has been worried about the whole episode.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但这正是德怀特这一整集都在担心的事。

sentences.en: Well, that was blood drive, everybody.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，今天的献血活动就到这里。
这就是今天的献血活动，大家再见。

sentences.en: I'm going to put on different shoes.
I encourage you to get a pair of flip-flops.
sentences.zh: 我建议你们买一双人字拖。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I guess I have to fix my hair.
sentences.zh: 对，而且我想我得整理一下头发。

sentences.en: Well, you do have one guy that's going,
sentences.zh: 好吧，你确实有一撮头发，

sentences.en: I'm moving into, I don't know what my fall hairdo is yet,
sentences.zh: 我要进入……我还不知道我的秋季发型是什么样的，

sentences.en: but we're transitioning out of bangs right now.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在正在从刘海过渡出去。

sentences.en: I can't wait to see what your fall hairdo is.
sentences.zh: 我等不及想看你的秋季发型了。

sentences.en: Well, I know I'm going to get the truth from you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我知道你会跟我说实话的。
